Supreme Court to Host Monthly Lectures and Annual Legal Award

On the occasion of Teacher's Day, Chief Justice of India (CJI) D.Y. Chandrachud announced plans for a new monthly lecture series at the Supreme Court. This series will focus on law, justice, and legal education. Additionally, the court will institute an annual award to recognize contributions to the legal field. The initiative aims to foster intellectual discourse and acknowledge excellence within the legal community.
